known_release_blockers: Whole-session reset publication is not yet qualified for TaskIR, actuator, tactile, presentation, and all physical reset state together.
Force-torque currently reports the final accepted physics-microstep resultant; configurable control-window integration and joint-transmission load-cell semantics are not implemented.
Presentation and tactile execution have not been folded into the common SensorIR schedule; dedicated contact-state, ray, LiDAR, and IMU operators remain incomplete.
Sensor-native counter-based corruption, recorder routing, and compiler dead-code elimination remain incomplete.

The canonical world executor still uses classic MTLCommandBuffer encoding and individually bound pass arguments; Metal 4 command allocators, generated argument tables, residency sets, and the final explicit-barrier graph are incomplete.
No general MJCF importer is present.
TaskIR still lacks named sites, frame acceleration, point and Jacobian quantities, sampled and trajectory goals, generic gates and reductions, and three qualified task families.
PolicyIR has no convolutional, residual, normalization, recurrent, or attention operators, and direct no-copy MLX-to-private-bank transfer remains incomplete.
No production native adjoint or discontinuity-validity API exists.
The G1 policy is not standing or walking qualification evidence.
The ten-million-transition release soak has not run.
